FULL TEXT:
Bhaderwah Campus
University of Jammu
(A++ Grade University Accredited by NAAC)
Date: 25-08-2026
No: BC/JU/Adm./26/233
NOTICE
This is for the information of all interested and eligible candidates that an Interview for engagement of
Teaching Faculty in Computer Science and Mathematics on Lecture Basis in UG-PG integrated course for
the current Academic Session/ semester will be held as per the following schedule:
Date: 31-08-2026 (Monday)
Reporting Time: 02:00 P.M.
Venue: Office of the Programme Coordinator, Integrated UG-PG Course, Bhaderwah Campus,
University of Jammu.
The engagement is purely temporary and need-based and shall continue only the end of the
session/semester. Candidates must possess the minimum qualifications prescribed under the UGC
Regulations, 2018, i.e., Master's Degree with at least 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET, or Ph.D. (as per
UGC Regulations, 2018). Interested candidates should report with their original certificates, self-attested
photocopies, updated CV and a recent passport-size photograph.
Note: The University reserves the right not to conduct interviews for any of the temporary
engagement on contract basis, advertised, (if circumstances so warrant), without assigning any
reason thereof.
Sd/-
Programme Cordinator,
Integrated UG-PG
Bhaderwah Campus.
Bhaderwah Campus
University of Jammu
(A++ Grade University Accredited by NAAC)
TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. The selected faculty shall be eligible for remuneration as per the University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits that are admissible to regular
employees of the University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular appointments at the University of
Jammu or for continued services in the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement at any time in case of
unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons/compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute or ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of
the University shall be final.
6. Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In Interview on prescribed date and
time along with all supporting documents in original.
Sd/-
Programme Cordinator,
Integrated UG-PG
Bhaderwah Campus.
